\begin{example} \end{example}[Vertical geodesic and geodesics in $U^2$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0194 1. ch31:31.3\group Hyperbolic isometries

The positive imaginary axis is minimizing, with $d_{U^2}(ia,ib)=\log (b/a)$. Mobius invariance then shows that all geodesics in $U^2$ are vertical lines or circles perpendicular to the real axis. \end{example}
